correctness.rationale: The domain \(\Omega(n)\le2\) has only the shapes \(p,p^2,pq\). The first two reduce modulo \(p-1\). For odd \(pq\), the proof establishes the reversible chain \(PQ\mid pq(P+1)(Q+1)\), \(P\mid Q+1\), \(Q=kP-1\), \(Q\mid p(P+1)\), \(Q\mid(k+1)(k+2)\), and finally \((kt-2)P=k+t+3\). The cases \(P=1\) and \(P\ge2\) are then exhausted by exact inequalities and divisibility.
